decisions: Headline: the Hebrew prints 'SEX FILES' in Latin capitals; rendered in title case as 'Sex Files: An Interview with David Duchovny', the nrg 'Rating' column format.
Section heading 'רצון ויכולת לזעזע' rendered 'Willing and Able to Shock', echoing Duchovny's own phrase in the next paragraph.
Section heading 'סדרה באפלה' (a pun on the Hebrew X-Files title 'Files in the Dark') rendered 'The Ex-Files'; a literal 'A Series in the Dark' carries no pun in English.

'האיגוד האמריקני למשוררים' rendered as the Academy of American Poets, the organization whose college prize Duchovny won at Princeton; the earlier draft's vague 'American society of poets' named nothing.
'אהובתו המיתולוגית' rendered 'the great love of his life'.
'קומדיה רגשנית' rendered 'a sentimental comedy'; 'הקשקוש של החיים' rendered 'the bullshit of life'.
'מדובר בדמות מפסידנית למדי, לא?' rendered 'The character's quite a loser, isn't he?'
Established English titles used: Californication, The X-Files, Red Shoe Diaries.
Quotations are translations of the published Hebrew in spoken register, not reconstructed English speech.
lostInTranslation: 'נע ונד' (Cain's 'fugitive and wanderer') is a biblical register the English 'wanders in and out' does not carry.
The Hebrew X-Files title 'תיקים באפלה' lets the second heading pun on 'files'; English readers meet the English title, so the heading pun was rebuilt rather than translated.

'50 by now' replaced with '50 already'; 'a once-successful novelist' replaced with 'a successful novelist (ret.)' to restore the במיל' joke.

'He finished his studies at Princeton with a degree in English literature' replaced with 'He graduated from Princeton in English literature'; 'dabbled in poetry' replaced with 'tinkered with poetry'; 'his handsome looks led him into modeling work' replaced with 'his good looks led him to modeling'.
